compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is part of a location-sharing application. The main contents and functions are as follows:

1. **Map Display**: A map is shown at the top of the screen, indicating the current location acquisition process.
2. **Send Glympse to**: The user can send their location to a contact on Facebook (Grace Chan).
3. **Watch me for**: The duration for which the location will be shared is set to 15 minutes.
4. **Saying**: There is an option to add a message to the location share.
5. **Going to**: The user can pick a destination to share along with their location.

The screen also includes standard navigation elements such as a back arrow and a send button at the top.
